arabic text: Karbal Main Aa Gaye Hai Karbal Basane Wale, Mola Madine Wale
english translation text: The people of Madina have arrived in Karbala, The Master of Madina has arrived.

arabic text: Khaime Saja Rahe Hai, Wada Nibha Ne Wale, Mola Madine Wale
english translation text: They are raising the tents, The ones who came to fulfil their promise.

arabic text:
Ye Dar Woh Pak Dar Hai Jo Fatima Ka Dar Hai
Ye Pyare Mustafa Maula Ali Ka Dar Hai
Maqtal Mein Aa Gaye Hai Quran Suna Ne Wale
english translation text: This is that sacred household, The house of Fatima.\nThis is the household of Mustafa and Ali.\nThey have come to the battlefield, The ones who will recite the Qur'an.

arabic text:
Islam Ne Pukara Quran Ne Sada Di
Yasrab Ka Shahzada Yasrab Ki Shahzadi
Nikle Safar Ko Ghar Se Kalma Bachane Wale
english translation text: Islam called out, And the Qur'an gave its summons.\nThe Prince of Yathrib and the Princess of Yathrib Set out from their home on this journey,\nThe ones who would preserve the Kalimah.

arabic text:
Ro Ro Ke Boli Sughra Dil Doob Ta Hai Mera
Weeran Kiya Madina Jungle Mein Hai Basera
Mujh Ko Rulagye Kyun Khushian Luta Ne Wale
english translation text: Weeping, Sughra cried out: My heart is sinking with grief.\nMadina has been left desolate, While your dwelling is now in the wilderness.\nWhy have you left me weeping, O you who brought us joy?

arabic text:
Daamad Ke Dulhare Beti Ke Shahzade
Ye Teen Deen Ke Pyase Sub Phool Mustufa Ke
Katre Ko Hai Yehi Tu Daria Banane Wale
english translation text: The sons-in-law's beloved sons,\nThe grandsons of the daughter of the Prophet,\nThese three-day thirsty flowers of Mustafa, Were the very drops destined To become an ocean.

arabic text:
Sub Lut Gayi Kamaie Akbar Ne Barchi Khayi
Asgar Ne Teer Khaya Deti Thi Maan Duhayi
Teeron Ke Saye Mein Hai Sajde Mein Jane Wale
english translation text: All that was treasured has been lost. Akbar was struck by a spear.\nAsghar was struck by an arrow. His mother cried out in anguish.\nBeneath a rain of arrows stands The one who goes into sajdah.

arabic text:
Halmin Ka Istegasa Jub De Chuka Woh Pyasa
Aawaz E Irjaie Ne Aa Kar Diya Dilasa
Aa Mere Paas Aaja Lashe Utha Ne Wale
english translation text:
When the thirsty one had made his final call of "Hal min
Nasir", The voice of return came to comfort him. "Come to Me
now, O you who have carried the bodies of the martyrs."

arabic text:
Ek Shor Tha Falaq Par Kehta Tha Rab E Akbar
Jibril Badalon Ka Jaldi Bichao Bistar
Jannat Main Aa Rahe Hai Quran Bachane Wale
english translation text: A cry arose across the heavens. The Lord of Majesty proclaimed:\n"Jibra'il,\nquickly spread the carpets of the clouds." For entering Paradise are The ones who preserved the Qur'an.
